context.content_translation:
在 Links Fine Meats，我们以提供市场上最高品质的产品而自豪。
A. oneself
B. yourselves
C. itself
D. ourselves 1’

items.question: At Links Fine Meats, we pride ------- on providing the highest-quality products on the market.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“ourselves 1’”代入题干后为“At Links Fine Meats, we pride ourselves 1’ on providing the highest-quality products on the market.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（ourselves 1’）。
